recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-22099 unless a separate cleanup effort decides to remove obsolete unreferenced draft/proposal files from resource folders.
issue_request: FHIR-22099 asked to document _since as a common search parameter after confusion among _since, _lastUpdated, Subscription, and Bulk Data usage. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: do not add _since to common search parameters; treat it as a specialized history/operation parameter; update Subscription to use _lastUpdated.
initial_application: Commit 6123ca87d90300306078f8dd2cd121fb93a4c54e explicitly applied FHIR-22099 by changing the Subscription empty-payload guidance from _since to _lastUpdated and fixing nearby typos before R5.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes the Subscription resources. Current source/search.html documents _lastUpdated as the common search parameter and has no _since entry or SearchParameter definition. Current source/http.html keeps _since in the history interaction parameter table with no prefixes or modifiers, matching the resolution. The only Subscription-folder _since occurrence is in source/subscription/josh proposal.txt, an unreferenced draft/proposal file rather than authoritative build content. Zulip confirms Subscription uses FHIR search and must use defined search parameters, while operation-style uses such as Bulk Data/$everything can define their own _since parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the build-scoped FHIR core source already implements the final decision.
